SELECT a.apr20_relate_ics_id AS relate_ics_id , a.apr20_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.ics01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , b.ics01_content AS content , b.ics01_submit_to AS submit_to , b.ics01_related_law AS related_law , a.apr20_deadline_id AS deadline_id , f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_full_name , c.sch03_note AS deadline_note , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , a.apr20_stand_cd AS stand_code , a.apr20_stand_date AS stand_date , a.apr20_close_date AS close_date , a.apr20_stand_yn AS stand_yn FROM apr20_relate_ics a INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree b ON a.apr20_class_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_deadline_id = a.apr20_deadline_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') WHERE 1=1 AND apr20_appr_id = #{apprId}

SELECT NULL::numeric AS relate_id , t.class_tree_id , t.class_tree_name , t.class_tree_full_name , t.content , t.submit_to , NULL AS related_law , t.cycle_name , t.deadline_id , t.deadline_full_name , t.deadline_note , CASE WHEN t.note = '99' THEN '참고' ELSE '' END AS schedule_code_check , CASE WHEN t.note = '99' THEN NULL ELSE f_sysdate()::date END AS close_date FROM ( SELECT '99' AS note , b.ics01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , b.ics01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , b.ics01_content AS content , b.ics01_submit_to AS submit_to , c.sch03_deadline_id AS deadline_id , f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.ics01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_full_name , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , c.sch03_note AS deadline_note FROM dcr20_relate_ics a INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree b ON a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_info_id = a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') AND c.sch03_company_id = b.ics01_company_id WHERE 1=1 AND dcr20_dcr_class_tree_id = #{dcrClassTreeId} UNION SELECT '' AS note , b.ics01_class_tree_id , b.ics01_class_tree_nm , b.ics01_content , b.ics01_submit_to , c.sch03_deadline_id , f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.ics01_class_tree_id) , f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) , c.sch03_note FROM dcr20_relate_ics a INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree b ON a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_info_id = a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') AND c.sch03_company_id = b.ics01_company_id WHERE 1=1 AND dcr20_ics_class_tree_id = #{icsClassTreeId} ) t ORDER BY t.note

SELECT t.relate_fund_id AS relate_fund_id , t.apr03_fund_id AS fund_id , t.kofia_type_nm AS fund_type_name , t.fund_cd AS fund_code , t.fund_nm AS fund_name , t.apr03_print_yn AS print_yn , t.apr03_after_yn AS after_yn FROM ( SELECT fund_cd , CASE WHEN fund_id IS NOT NULL THEN f_get_fund_nm2(fund_id, f_today()::date) ELSE '' END AS fund_nm , ( SELECT f_cdnm('IcamFundType', fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd, apr03.apr01_company_id, fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = apr03.apr03_fund_id AND fnd02_work_date = f_max_workdate(fnd02_fund_code_id, f_trunc(apr03.apr01_reg_date)) LIMIT 1 ) AS kofia_type_nm , apr03.apr03_relate_fund_id AS relate_fund_id , apr03.apr03_fund_id , apr03.apr03_print_yn , apr03.apr03_after_yn FROM ( SELECT apr03_relate_fund.* , apr01_company_id , apr01_reg_date , COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id, fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id) AS fund_id , COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_cd, fnd01.fnd01_fund_cd) AS fund_cd FROM apr03_relate_fund INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr03_appr_id INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01_r ON fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id WHERE apr03_appr_id = #{apprId} ) apr03 ) t ORDER BY t.fund_cd DESC
